title: Amshuman searches for the horse
introduction: Amshuman's search for horse reveals that Kapila rendered his paternal-uncles to ashes. When he wanted to offer water oblation as obsequies to their souls he did not find water. Then Garuda, the Eagle-vehicle of Vishnu and maternal uncle of Amshuman advises him to get River Ganga onto earth whereby the souls are cleansed and they go to heaven. Amshuman reports the same to King Sagara, but Sagara not finding any way to get River Ganga onto earth departs to heaven at the end of his time.
closing: इति वाल्मीकिरामायणे आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे एकचत्वारिंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 41st chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
पुत्रांश्चिरगतान् ज्ञात्वा सगरो रघुनंदन |
नप्तारमब्रवीद्राजा दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा
verses.iast:
putrān cira gatān jñātvā sagaro raghunandana |
naptāram abravīt rājā dīpyamānam sva tejasā
verses.translation: "On observing that his sons have gone long time back in search of ritual-horse, oh, Rama, king Sagara spoke this to his grandson, Amshuman, who is radiant with his own self-resplendence." Thus Vishvamitra continued his narration about Sagara.

glosses.meaning: sons, long time back, have gone - for searching horse
on knowing, on recalling to mind
with his own, resplendence, who is resplendent

verses.devanagari:
शूरश्च कृतविद्यश्च पूर्वैस्तुल्योऽसि तेजसा |
पितृणां गतिमन्विच्छ येन चाश्वोऽपहारितः
verses.iast:
śūraḥ ca kṛta vidyaḥ ca pūrvaiḥ tulyo asi tejasā |
pitṛṇām gatim anviccha yena ca aśvo apahāritaḥ
verses.translation: " 'You are brave one and completed your education in warfare, such as you are, you are a coequal to your paternal-uncles in magnificence, thus you search the course of your paternal uncles, also him by whom the horse is stolen.' Thus King Sagara started speaking to his grandson Amshuman.

glosses.meaning: [you are a] brave one, also, completed, education [in warfare]
with [your] fathers [paternal-uncles,] equal to, you are
horse, by whom, stolen, also. - you fin out.

verses.devanagari:
अन्तर्भौमानि सत्त्वानि वीर्यवन्ति महान्ति च |
तेषां त्वं प्रतिघातार्थं सासिं गृह्णीष्व कार्मुकम्
verses.iast:
antar bhaumāni sattvāni vīryavanti mahānti ca |
teṣām tvam pratighāta artham sa asim gṛhṇīṣva kārmukam
verses.translation: " 'The living beings in netherworlds of earth are intrepid and they are extraordinary also, hence you take your bow along with your sword to retaliate them in the event of their attacking you.

glosses.meaning: underneath, earth, beings - living beings in netherworlds
you, their, retaliation [if they attack you,] for the purpose of
bow, you take up - you wield.

verses.devanagari:
अभिवाद्याभिवाद्यांस्त्वां हत्वा विघ्नकरानपि |
सिद्धार्थः संनिवर्तस्व मम यज्ञस्य पारगः
verses.iast:
abhivādya abhivādyān tvam hatvā vighna karān api |
siddhārthaḥ saṃnivartasva mama yajñasya pāragaḥ
verses.translation: " 'On saluting them that are worthy for salutations, and on eliminating them that are the causer of obstructions, you shall achieve your purpose of tracking the ritual-horse, and thus you comeback safely and let my Vedic-ritual be crossed over to the other shore of mortality by you.' Thus king Sagara told his grandson Amshuman.

glosses.meaning: those that are to be saluted
to other shore, be crossed over

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्तो ंऽशुमान् सम्यक्सगरेण महात्मना |
धनुरादाय खड्गं च जगाम लघुविक्रमः
verses.iast:
evam ukto aṃśumān saṃyak sagareṇa mahātmanā |
dhanur ādāya khaḍgam ca jagāma laghuvikramaḥ
verses.translation: "When the great-souled king Sagara has thoroughly said in this way, that adroitly agile Amshuman proceeded wielding a bow and a sword.

verses.devanagari:
स खातं पितृभिर्मार्गमन्तर्भौमं महात्मभिः |
प्रापद्यत नरश्रेष्ठ तेन राज्ञाभिचोदितः
verses.iast:
sa khātam pitṛbhiḥ mārgam antar bhaumam mahātmabhiḥ |
prāpadyata naraśreṣṭha tena rājñā abhicoditaḥ
verses.translation: "Motivated by the King Sagara, oh, Rama, the best one among men, Amshuman progressed on the walkway that was hollowed out by his great-souled paternal-uncles inside the earth.

glosses.meaning: oh, best one among men - Rama
by him, that king, motivated by
by great-souled ones, by fathers - paternal-uncles
he attained - progressed on that path.

verses.devanagari:
देवदानवरक्षोभिः पिशाचपतगोरगैः |
पूज्यमानं महातेजा दिशागजमपश्यत
verses.iast:
deva dānava rakṣobhiḥ piśāca pataga uragaiḥ |
pūjyamānam mahātejā diśā gajam apaśyata
verses.translation: "And he that resplendent Amshuman beheld one of the four directional elephant of the earth which is being venerated by gods, monsters, demons, imps, vultures and serpents.

verses.devanagari:
स तं प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा पृष्ट्वा चैव निरामयम् |
पितृन् स परिपप्रच्छ वाजिहर्तारमेव च
verses.iast:
sa tam pradakṣiṇam kṛtvā pṛṣṭvā caiva nirāmayam |
pitṛin sa paripapraccha vāji hartāram eva ca
verses.translation: On circumambulating that elephant in supplication, and even on enquiring after its well-being, he that Amshuman has enquired in detail with it for his paternal-uncles and even about the robber of the ritual-horse.

glosses.meaning: well being, on asking, also, even

verses.devanagari:
दिशागजस्तु तच्छ्रुत्वा प्रत्युवाच महामतिः |
आसमंज कृतार्थस्त्वं सहाश्वः शीघ्रमेष्यसि
verses.iast:
diśā gajaḥ tu tat śrutvā pratyuvāca mahāmatiḥ |
āsamañja kṛtārthaḥ tvam saha aśvaḥ śīghram eṣyasi
verses.translation: "On hearing that enquiry of Amshuman that directional elephant with great perception replied on its part saying, 'oh Amshuman, son of Asamanja, on achieving your mission you will return expeditiously along with the horse.

glosses.meaning: along with, horse, expeditiously, you will proceed - you will return.

verses.devanagari:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सर्वानेव दिशागजान् |
यथाक्रमं यथान्यायं प्रष्टुं समुपचक्रमे
verses.iast:
tasya tad vacanam śrutvā sarvān eva diśā gajān |
yathā kramam yathā nyāyam praṣṭum samupacakrame
verses.translation: "On hearing that word of that directional elephant he departed from there, and on sequentially reaching other directional elephants that are abiding in other directions of earth, he commenced to ask the same enquiry which he made with the first, according to the positioning of elephants in directions, and according to the established procedures of their venerability.

glosses.meaning: according to, positioning, [i.e., their standing, north, east, south, west etc.,] according to, procedure

verses.devanagari:
तैश्च सर्वैर्दिशापालैर्वाक्यज्ञैर्वाक्यकोविदैः |
पूजितः सहयश्चैव गन्तासीत्यभिचोदितः
verses.iast:
taiḥ ca sarvaiḥ diśā pālaiḥ vākyajñaiḥ vākyakovidaiḥ |
pūjitaḥ sa hayaḥ caiva gantā asi iti abhicoditaḥ
verses.translation: "All the elephants that safeguard the directions of earth which have the faculties of articulation and eloquence have adored Amshuman and motivated him by saying, 'you will be going from here taking the horse.'

glosses.meaning: sentence, knowers, sentence-making, experts in - articulate, eloquent
by all, of them, directions, safeguarding elephants
gone, you will be, thus, motivated.

verses.devanagari:
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा जगाम लघुविक्रमः |
भस्मराशीकृता यत्र पितरस्तस्य सागराः
verses.iast:
teṣām tat vacanam śrutvā jagāma laghuvikramaḥ |
bhasma rāśī kṛtā yatra pitaraḥ tasya sāgarāḥ
verses.translation: "On hearing that common blessing of all the directional-elephants, he that nimble-footed Amshuman has gone to the place where his paternal-uncles, sons of Sagara, were rendered as mounds of ashes.

glosses.meaning: of them [elephants,] that, word - common blessing, on hearing

verses.devanagari:
स दुःखवशमापन्नस्त्वसमंजसुतस्तदा |
चुक्रोश परमार्तस्तु वधात्तेषां सुदुःखितः
verses.iast:
sa duḥkha vaśam āpannaḥ tu asamañja sutaḥ tadā |
cukrośa parama ārtaḥ tu vadhāt teṣām suduḥkhitaḥ
verses.translation: "But he on whom the control of anguish has chanced for not physically seeing his paternal-uncles, that son of Asamanja then wept, as he is highly agonised and extremely anguished at their destruction.

glosses.meaning: anguish, into control, chanced upon, but
their - paternal-uncles, at the destruction, extremely, anguished

verses.devanagari:
यज्ञियं च हयं तत्र चरन्तमविदूरतः |
ददर्श पुरुषव्याघ्रो दुःखशोकसमन्वितः
verses.iast:
yajñiyam ca hayam tatra carantam avidūrataḥ |
dadarśa puruṣavyāghro duḥkha śoka samanvitaḥ
verses.translation: "That tigerly-man Amshuman who is overwhelmed by agony and anguish, also beheld there the horse of Vedic-ritual that is grazing nearby.

glosses.meaning: by anguish, agony, one who is overwhelmed

verses.devanagari:
स तेषां राजपुत्राणां कर्तुकामो जलक्रियाम् |
स जलार्थं महातेजा न चापश्यज्जलाशयम्
verses.iast:
sa teṣām rāja putrāṇām kartu kāmo jala kriyām |
sa jalārtham mahātejā na ca apaśyat jala āśayam
verses.translation: "When he that great resplendent Amshuman wanted to offer obsequial waters to the departed sons of Sagara and searched for water he has not found any fount of water.

glosses.meaning: for them, king's, sons - to the departed souls
[obsequial] water, oblation, to offer, wanted to
water, for the purpose of - when searched for
he, not, has seen - found, also.

verses.devanagari:
विसार्य निपुणां दृष्टिं ततोऽपश्यत् खगाधिपम् |
पितृणां मातुलं राम सुपर्णमनिलोपमम्
verses.iast:
visārya nipuṇām dṛṣṭim tato apaśyat khaga adhipam |
pitṛṇām mātulam rāma suparṇam anila upamam
verses.translation: "Spanning his expert glances, oh, Rama, he then saw the rapid-winged king of birds, namely Garuda, the Eagle-vehicle of Vishnu, who is the maternal uncle of his father and other paternal-uncles, and whose flight will be similar to that of the Wind-god.

verses.devanagari:
स चैनमब्रवीद्वाक्यं वैनतेयो महाबलः |
मा शुचः पुरुषव्याघ्र वधोऽयं लोकसम्मतः
verses.iast:
sa ca enam abravīt vākyam vainateyo mahābalaḥ |
mā śucaḥ puruṣavyāghra vadho ayam loka sammataḥ
verses.translation: "That great-mighty son of Lady Vinata, namely Garuda, also spoke this word to Amshuman, 'do not bemoan, oh, tigerly-man, this eradication of your paternal-uncles is worthwhile to the worlds.

glosses.meaning: he, that son of Vinata - Garuda
to him - to Amshuman, sentence, spoke, also
this, eradication [of your paternal-uncles,] agreeable [worthwhile] to the worlds.

verses.devanagari:
कपिलेनाप्रमेयेण दग्धा हीमे महाबलाः |
सलिलं नार्हसि प्राज्ञ दातुमेषां हि लौकिकम्
verses.iast:
kapilena aprameyeṇa dagdhā hi ime mahābalāḥ |
salilam na ar.hhasi prājña dātum eṣām hi laukikam
verses.translation: " 'In fact, Kapila, the Imponderable Sage, has burnt down those great-mighty paternal-uncles of yours, oh, observant Amshuman, as such it will not be apt of you to offer the mundane obsequial water-oblations to them, indeed.

glosses.meaning: by the Imponderable one, by Kapila
to them, mundane [obsequial water-oblations,] to offer

verses.devanagari:
गंगा हिमवतो ज्येष्ठा दुहिता पुरुषर्षभ |
तस्यां कुरु महाबाहो पितॄणां तु जलक्रियाम्
verses.iast:
gaṅgā himavato jyeṣṭhā duhitā puruṣarṣabha |
tasyām kuru mahābāho pitṝṇām tu jala kriyām
verses.translation: " 'Oh, best one among men, River Ganga is the elder daughter of Himavanta, and oh, dextrous one, you have to offer water-oblation to the departed paternal-uncles of yours in her waters, namely the holy waters of River Ganga.

glosses.meaning: Himavanta's, elder, daughter, Ganga - is there
[to your departed] fathers [paternal-uncles,] but, water, oblation
in her, [in Ganga waters,] you offer - you have to offer.

verses.devanagari:
भस्मराशीकृतानेतान् प्लावयेल्लोकपावनी |
तया क्लिन्नमिदं भस्म गंगया लोककान्तया |
षष्टिं पुत्रसहस्राणि स्वर्गलोकं गमिष्यति
verses.iast:
bhasma rāśī kṛtān etān pāvayet loka kāntayā |
tayā klinnam idam bhasma gaṅgayā loka kāntayā |
ṣaṣṭim putra sahasrāṇi svarga lokam gamiṣyati
verses.translation: " 'World purifier River Ganga will drift them who are rendered as mounds of ashes to heaven, and when she who is much adored by all worlds drenches this ash, that River Ganga herself will lead the sixty-thousand sons of Sagara to heaven.

glosses.meaning: them [sons of Sagara,] drifts - to heavens
to empyrean, world, she can lead them.

verses.devanagari:
गच्छ चाश्वं महाभाग संगृह्य पुरुषर्षभ |
यज्ञं पैतामहं वीर निर्वर्तयितुमर्हसि
verses.iast:
nir.hgaccha ca aśvam mahābhāga saṅgṛhya puruṣarṣabha |
yajñam paitāmaham vīra nirvartayitum arhasi
verses.translation: " 'Oh, great fortunate one, oh, best one among men, you may proceed from here with the horse, oh, brave one, it will be apt of you to carry out the Vedic-ritual of your grandfather.' Thus Garuda said to Amshuman.

glosses.meaning: horse, on taking, out, you go - you may proceed from here
of grand father, Vedic- ritual, to carry out, apt of you.

verses.devanagari:
सुपर्णवचनं श्रुत्वा सोंऽशुमानतिवीर्यवान् |
त्वरितं हयमादाय पुनरायान्महायशाः
verses.iast:
suparṇa vacanam śrutvā saḥ aṃśumān ativīryavān |
tvaritam hayam ādāya punar āyāt mahāyaśāḥ
verses.translation: "On hearing the words of that great-winged eagle, Garuda, he that highly brave and well-renowned Amshuman swiftly took the horse, and returned to the ritual place of his grandfather, king Sagara.

glosses.meaning: again, came- returned to his grandfather.

verses.devanagari:
ततो राजानमासाद्य दीक्षितं रघुनंदन |
न्यवेदयद्यथावृत्तं सुपर्णवचनं तथा
verses.iast:
tato rājānam āsādya dīkṣitam raghunandana |
nyavedayat yathā vṛttam suparṇa vacanam tathā
verses.translation: "Then on reaching the King Sagara, who is under the vow of the ritual, oh, Rama, Amshuman described what all has happened and even the words of Garuda.

glosses.meaning: oh, Rama, the descendant of Raghu
under vow, king, on getting at

verses.devanagari:
तच्छ्रुत्वा घोरसंकाशं वाक्यमंशुमतो नृपः |
यज्ञं निर्वर्तयामास यथाकल्पं यथाविधि
verses.iast:
tat śrutvā ghora saṅkāśam vākyam aṃśumato nṛpaḥ |
yajñam nirvartayāmāsa yathā kalpam yathā vidhi
verses.translation: "On hearing those unendurable words from Amshuman, the king Sagara firstly completed the Vedic-ritual scripturally and procedurally.

glosses.meaning: as per, scriptures, as per procedure
Vedic ritual, restarted to - firstly - complete, and to see bout Ganga later.

verses.devanagari:
स्वपुरं चागमच्छ्रीमानिष्टयज्ञो महीपतिः |
गंगायाश्चागमे राजा निश्चयं नाध्यगच्छत
verses.iast:
sva puram ca agamat śrīmān iṣṭa yajño mahīpatiḥ |
gaṅgāyāḥ ca āgame rājā niścayam na adhyagacchata
verses.translation: "On completing the Vedic-ritual King Sagara arrived at his capital, but that king could not arrive at a decision about the arrival of Ganga to the earth.

glosses.meaning: fortunate one, land, lord - king Sagara

verses.devanagari:
अगत्वा निश्चयं राजा कालेन महता महान् |
त्रिंशद्वर्षसहस्राणि राज्यं कृत्वा दिवं गतः
verses.iast:
agatvā niścayam rājā kālena mahatā mahān |
triṃśat varṣa sahasrāṇi rājyam kṛtvā divam gataḥ
verses.translation: "That great king Sagara could not get at any resolve in getting Ganga to earth even after a long time, and on ruling kingdom for thirty-thousand years he went to heaven." Thus Vishvamitra continued his narration about the ancestors of Rama.

glosses.meaning: resolve, not, getting at - for Ganga's descent
kingdom, on ruling, to heaven, went to.
